stories.headline: Saudi brand Ceer unveils its first electric cars
stories.summary: Ceer Motors has unveiled the EXOBOT SUV and sedan in Saudi Arabia. They are the brand's first electric vehicles in the country. Ceer makes sedans and SUVs for the GCC region, and its name means drive forward in Arabic.

stories.headline: New Zealand votes the black robin its bird of the year
stories.summary: New Zealand's black robin has won Forest & Bird's Bird of the Year competition. It took more than 26,000 votes out of about 105,000. The critically endangered bird comes from the Chatham Islands, and in 1980 only five of them survived.

stories.headline: A campsite search in Quebec turns up an ancient crater
stories.summary: An amateur astronomer scouting campsites in the Quebec wilderness came across signs of an impact crater. Researchers who reached the site found shatter cones in the rock, which form under the pressures of an impact. The crater is about 25 kilometres across and roughly 390 million years old.
